subject: Train
observations: Locomotive front is now an ordinary blue boiler with no eye or smile; wheels, chimney and cab remain recognizable mechanical parts.
Large red, blue, yellow, orange, green and gray components retain engaging variety and repeated body/wheel regions; the former yellow facial panel is removed without undermining the palette.

anthropomorphism_review.observation: No anthropomorphic faces or character features on the object, props or decorative motifs.

processed_gate_checks: Preserve broad paint regions; do not number tiny shading, decorative strokes or background holes.
